Welcome
The Department of Chemistry & Biochemistry at UC Santa Cruz is an inclusive, supportive, and innovative community whose common goal is to create new chemical knowledge and to mentor the best and brightest students who will define the next frontiers of chemical science. As chemistry is central to modern science and is crucial to creating new knowledge and improving human experiences, we are committed to delivering quality education in our undergraduate and graduate degree programs, and to groundbreaking research in biomedical and materials science.

Explore the Facilities
The Department of Chemistry & Biochemistry boasts state-of-the-art facilities that provide cutting-edge resources for groundbreaking research and discovery.
Chemical Screening Center
The Chemical Screening Center (CSC) is a shared research facility providing instrumentation and chemical collections that aid in the discovery of therapeutic agents and biomedical research tools.
Biomolecular Cryo-Electron Microscopy Facility
The Biomolecular cryoEM Facility is a leading provider of cutting-edge structural biology solutions using transmission electron microscopy.
Macromolecular Structure Function Core Facility
The Macromolecular Structure Function Core Facility (MSFCF) provides state of the art instrumentation, supplies, and expertise to assist researchers in the structural characterization of biological macromolecules.
Mass Spectrometry
The Mass Spectrometry Facility provides analytical support for the Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry and others by housing the LC-MSLTQ and LTQ-Orbitrap Velos Pro MS.
NMR Facility
The NMR facility brings together an interdisciplinary group of researchers and manages three high resolution NMR spectrometers.
X-Ray Laboratory
The X-ray Facility offers advanced diffraction instrumentation for detailed structural analysis of crystals, powders, thin films, polymers, and gels using single crystal, powder, and thin film diffraction techniques.
